import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return (params[0]*x**1.5
            + params[1]*x/(1+params[2]*x)*v
            + params[3]*t*np.log(t)*x**1.5
            + params[4]*np.sin(params[5]*t+params[6]))
